name: shedflare
description: A self-hosted Cloudflare app suite for personal productivity tools.

scripts.site:deploy: vp build site && vp exec alchemy deploy site/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:auth: vp build apps/auth && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/auth/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:cf-bill: vp build apps/cf-bill && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/cf-bill/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:drive: vp build apps/drive && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/drive/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:chat: vp build apps/chat && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/chat/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:money: vp build apps/money && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/money/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:routines: vp build apps/routines && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/routines/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:youtube: vp build apps/youtube && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/youtube/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:observability: vp build apps/observability && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/observability/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.deploy:s: vp build apps/s && vp exec alchemy deploy apps/s/alchemy.run.ts --yes
scripts.test:auth: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/auth/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:cf-bill: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/cf-bill/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:drive: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/drive/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:chat: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/chat/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:money: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/money/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:youtube: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/youtube/alchemy.test.ts
scripts.test:s: SHEDFLARE_LIVE_ALCHEMY_TESTS=1 vp exec vitest run apps/s/alchemy.test.ts
